Generated Narrative: CodeSystem ehds-secondary-use-purpose-cs

This case-sensitive code system http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-secondary-use-purpose-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
public-health Public HealthActivities in the area of public health, including protection against serious cross-border threats to health and public-health surveillance.
policy-regulatory Policy-Making and Regulatory ActivitiesPublic-sector policy-making, planning, supervision, or regulatory activities in the health or care sectors.
statistics Official StatisticsPreparation and production of official statistics relating to health or care.
education-teaching Education or TeachingEducation or teaching activities in the health or care sectors.
scientific-research Scientific ResearchScientific research related to health or care that contributes to public health or health-technology development.
development-innovation Development and InnovationDevelopment and innovation activities for products, services, or processes contributing to public health, healthcare, or care.
algorithm-training-testing Training, Testing and Evaluation of AlgorithmsTraining, testing, and evaluation of algorithms, including algorithms used in medical devices, in-vitro diagnostic medical devices, AI systems, or digital health applications.
care-improvement Improvement of Care DeliveryActivities aimed at improving healthcare delivery, treatment, or the management of health systems.
